description: Has this provider, grantee, or contractor settled a case under HHS-OIG's Self-Disclosure Protocol or Grant Self-Disclosure Program? Checks a name against the current list of settled self-disclosure enforcement actions — an exact title match is the strongest signal; a provider-name or token match is returned as a labelled CANDIDATE. For the best match, fetches the settlement's own detail page LIVE to return the exact settlement amount, the full entity description, and the complete allegation narrative — none of that is baked, so it is never stale (the headline figure is often a rounded approximation of it). Returns found:false with the list's as-of date and total settlement count when no match exists. Sourced from HHS-OIG, keyless.

limit.description: Maximum candidates to return (default 5, max 20). Only the top/best candidate is enriched with live detail-page data.

name.description: Provider, grantee, or contractor name to check, e.g. "Baptist Health Brookwood Hospital". Any word order; partial names are matched as candidates.

program.description: Restrict the search to one program (default "all").

name: oig_sdp_check
title: Oig Sdp Check
